text: Let every clone emit expiring failure pheromones keyed by semantic cause, so later agents instinctively choose probes that discriminate the colony's unresolved hypotheses instead of repeating repairs.
rationale: The fleet converts failed work into decentralized experiment routing without assigning a coordinator.

text: Make proof lanes publish tiny signed capability spores, and let each PR assemble a quorum from independently evolved lane implementations rather than trusting one canonical battery.
rationale: Diverse validators expose shared blind spots while successful proof forms spread through local adoption.

text: Give pipeline rules reproductive fitness: clones randomly mutate one rule, replay recent squash histories, and propagate only mutations whose descendants merge with fewer reversions and escaped defects.
rationale: Optimization becomes selection on downstream survival instead of tuning the measurements already present in the ledger.

text: Seed each touched symbol with a suspicion token that reviewers consume only by producing a counterexample, invariant, or executable witness, causing review depth to swarm around uncertainty rather than file size.
rationale: Local review artifacts attract scrutiny exactly where confidence is weakest and disappear only through evidence.

text: Turn sibling clones into an immune repertoire where each permanently specializes in one historical failure phenotype and automatically challenges new PRs with adversarial variants of that phenotype.
rationale: The colony retains heterogeneous defensive memory even after squash merges erase the exploratory path.

text: Allow agents to leave reversible architectural scent marks on abstractions they repeatedly misunderstand, then automatically trigger simplification contests when independent clones accumulate the same scent.
rationale: Recurring agent confusion becomes a distributed signal for redesign that ordinary timing and failure ledgers cannot see.
